propositions: Plan-review grounding finders flag symbols as missing when a prerequisite ticket (via depends_on edge) will create them, despite existing prose documentation stating such symbols should be treated as existing

The [rebar:<id>] citation grammar must be parsed and honored in two layers: Layer 1 deterministic advisory edge verification (both depends_on and reverse blocks directions), and Layer 2 LLM coverage judgment via show_ticket tool

Layer 1 citation verification must be advisory only (never blocking, respecting det_floor fail-open architecture) and must validate that cited ticket id is an upstream prerequisite via bidirectional edge check (P.depends_on(C) or C.blocks(P))

Layer 2 LLM coverage protocol must retrieve cited ticket via show_ticket and affirmatively confirm its plan/file_impact provides the specific functionality before crediting the citation and suppressing the finding
Failed reverse-lookup or missing edge must fail-closed by treating citation as unverified and allowing the normal missing-symbol finding to stand
Author guidance and regenerated criteria guide must document the [rebar:<id>] citation syntax and fail-closed semantics for cited-but-unverified or coverage-absent citations
